title_en: Character Riddles (1/20): The Rising Sun Riddle
note_en: 孙女想了半天也没猜出来 means "she thought for ages but couldn't guess it." 猜出来 is a verb plus result complement: 猜 "guess" + 出来 "out," i.e. guessing successfully. To say the result never came, Chinese puts 没 in front of the whole unit (没猜出来), where English simply says "couldn't guess."
